title: The Rooftop Chase
text: Masked figures leap across the rooftops overhead, quick as cats, carrying something that belongs to your House. One of them stops at a chimney to look back and wave. Then they are gone over the ridge.

options.label: The fastest goes over the rooftops after them to take back what is the House's.

outcomes.text: They catch the thief at the edge of a gutter. It is yours again.
A tile slips, and they land badly.

options.label: Follow from the street below, keeping them in sight.

outcomes.text: You lose them among the masks, and lose a purse with them.

options.label: The cleverest guesses where they will come down, and waits there.

outcomes.text: They are waiting when the thieves come down, which nobody expected.
